lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five horizontal rows of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in a grid-like formation posterior to the gill slits. The highest intensity maxima are concentrated in the second and third rows from the dorsal ridge, exhibiting a regular inter-blob spacing of roughly 1.5 to 2 blob diameters.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows, creating high-contrast anchor nodes. These vertical bands are most defined in the mid-lateral section, becoming more diffuse towards the ventral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible. The primary carina shows a high-contrast gradient with a light-to-dark transition moving dorsally to ventrally, maintaining a linear trajectory from the posterior of the head through the caudal region.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A dense population of small, low-diameter high-luminance blobs is visible on the leading edge and upper third of the first dorsal fin. The central and posterior portions of the fin's macro-mask are partially occluded by a commensal organism.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple Echeneidae (remora) specimens, with the most prominent individual attached to the dorsal-lateral surface immediately anterior to the first dorsal fin.
